name: interactive-list-preview
title: Interactive List Preview
description: Hover-driven table list that reveals clipped images with a sliding highlight bar and mix-blend-mode difference inversion effect

changelog.summary: Removed the public items/previewPlacement controls and replaced the stale control set with working imageSize, duration, smoothness, and lerp props.

Added items as a public prop with a working remixer panel. The originally suggested previewPlacement/activeIndex/accentColor/duration props don't exist - the preview image position, colors, and timings are fixed in InteractiveListPreviewComp - so they were dropped rather than shipping non-functional controls.
Renamed helper ListHover.jsx to InteractiveListPreviewComp.jsx (default export) to match the production naming convention and eliminate registry/docs mirror drift.
Under reduced motion, single-image opacity fade and no cursor parallax

props.name: imageSize
props.description: Scale multiplier for the hover preview image.

props.name: duration
props.description: Preview image reveal and hide duration.

props.name: smoothness
props.description: Highlight and row text transition smoothing duration.

props.name: lerp
props.description: Pointer-follow smoothing amount; higher values track faster.
